title: Unique perspective on the history of Gaudi's work
text: Pia was a great guide and I had a wonderful experience. Pia was very knowledgeable about many things including the personal history of Gaudi and the engineering behind many of his works which created an interesting perspective I doubt I would have been able to obtain through any other means. I definitely will be doing more tours!
author: ccJ658NV

title: For people really interested in architecture
text:
I can’t recommend this tour enough. I took the Gaudi tour. We really enjoyed hanging out with Pia. Her depth of knowledge of architecture, history, and engineering enabled her to provide a really informative tour. In addition to learning more about Gaudi and his buildings than we did on the official tours at those buildings, as we walked the streets of Barcelona, Pia was able to provide a lot of context for how the city was planned and where Gaudi fit.
This tour is for people who enjoy learning and really want to understand what they’re seeing.
author: P182QHjs

title: Best Walking Tour ever!
text: Best walking tour ever! Pia was exceptional tour guide. Having an architect’s background and knowledge of a city from an historical, societal, cultural as well as architectural perspective provided a very rich experience. Pia answered all of our many questions with an obvious love of teaching and learning. How lucky her university students must be. My husband and I would highly recommend this tour.
author: Connectheworld

title: Marvel at Barcelona through different eyes
text:
Barcelona is an exciting city - and on our Architectural Walk, we learned to see the city through completely different eyes once again. From urban development to the present day - everything was made vivid and tangible based on the immediate surroundings - and really exciting! The highlights were Gaudi's buildings, specifically his less famous ones as well - along with the respective stories behind them. But many other buildings, small courtyards, special facades, or street layouts suddenly took on different meanings and left us amazed.

Bianca was a wonderful guide! She shared her vast wealth
author: M6329XDandream

title: Sunday Barcelona Architectural Stroll
text: An excellent and detailed tour hosted by Rafael. We enjoyed the descriptions of the famed Gaudi buildings, Casa Battlo and La Pedrera as well as the lesser known Casa Calvet. Rafael provided a nice synopsis of the development of Barcelona from the Ciutat Vella and history of L'Eixample. Our three-hour tour was a most pleasant stroll through the greening pedestrian spaces of L'Eixample. Distinguishing features such as the Gaudi pavement stones, chamfered corners were interesting to learn about. We enjoyed learning about the architectural details of Casa Amatller, Casa Lleo Morera, and Fundacio
author: Y2631NNstevenw

title: Guille Brings Gaudí’s Genius to Life
text:
This was my second tour with BAW, and it was every bit as fantastic as the first! If you’re looking for an immersive, memorable experience for your group, I highly recommend this tour.
After such a wonderful experience last year, I specifically requested Guille as our guide again—and once again, he was exceptional. His knowledge of Gaudí, the history of the Sagrada Família, and the fascinating stories behind its design and construction truly brought this incredible place to life.

title: Excellent guided tour for people with interest in architecture
text: We had a three hours tour with Pia, an architect who teaches at university in Barcelona and has an international experience and background. We were three couples and the walk was very informative and pleasant. author: scheidereit

title: Magnificent "off the beaten path" tour of Barcelona
text: It is really a very interesting activity for a first time in Barcelona, very complementary to visiting only the major monuments. Bianca, our guide, explained to us how the city developed, how the locals of Barcelona took ownership of the new neighborhoods, and showed it to us through the architecture.  It is a very privileged "off the track" walk without the other tourists. Bianca led this discovery with brilliance, kindness, and liveliness. It was great 🤩🤩🤩🤩. I highly recommend the guide and the organization.
author: Didou0613

title: Great experience with Bianca
text: Bianca was a great tour guide. She was really knowledgeable and passionate about Barcelona and architecture. She gives a holistic perspective of Barcelona - intertwining history, culture, and technical aspects.
author: mitchellh92

title: #1 Must-Do Tour in Barcelona
text:
We did the Barcelona & Gaudi tour our first day in Barcelona. The tour was amazing, and led by Pia our insanely knowledgable guide. She gave us a history of the city, how and why it is built the way it is, the influences of Gaudi and other architects/designers, and a generally understanding of Barcelona. This tour set the stage for every single thing we did on our trip. The different neighborhoods of the city were explained in a way that we could feel the changes as we walked around, not just visually but the personality of the neighborhoods.
